sentences.text:
Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.
Hon'ble Ramesh Sinha,J.
Hon'ble Raj Beer Singh,J.

Heard Sri Vinit Singh, holding brief of Sri Ashutosh Kumar Pandey, learned counsel for the
petitioners, Ms. Archana Singh, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the impugned F.I.R. as well
as material brought on record.

This petition has been filed by the petitioners with a prayer to quash the F.I.R. dated 29.06.2020
registered as case crime no. 459 of 2020 under section 3(1) of U.P. Gangster & Anti-social Activities
Act, 1986, police station Mohamdabad, District Mau.

Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that in the gang chart only one case has been shown against the petitioners i.e., Case Crime No. 440 of 2020, under Sections 188, 269 IPC, Section 3 Epidemic Act, Section 5/8 of Environment (Protection) Act and Section 31(1)/63 Food Safety and Standards Act in which petitioners have already been enlarged on bail.

He further submits that the Parasnath Sonkar Alias Paras And ... vs State Of U.P. And 2 Others on 31 July, 2020 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/191673724/
1 impugned F.I.R. under the Gangster Act, has been lodged against the petitioners, when in fact, they are neither the member of any gang nor they run any gang involved in anti-social activities.

entities.text: Parasnath Sonkar Alias Paras And ... vs State Of U.P. And 2 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The allegation levelled against the petitioners is absolutely false, frivolous and baseless.
No offence is made out against the petitioners, hence the FIR is liable to be quashed by this Court.
Learned A.G.A. opposed the prayer for quashing of the F.I.R.

Considering the submissions advanced by learned counsel for the parties and nature of the allegations, it is directed that the petitioners shall not be arrested in the above mentioned case, till the submission of the police report under section 173(2) Cr.P.C., if any before the competent Court,
but shall co-operate with the investigation of the case.
With the above direction, this petition is finally disposed of.
The party shall file computer generated copy of such order downloaded from the official website of High Court Allahabad, self attested by petitioner(s).

The concerned Court/Authority/Official shall verify the authenticity of such computerized copy of the order from the official website of High Court Allahabad and shall make a declaration of such verification in writing.
.
(Raj Beer Singh, J.) (Ramesh Sinha, J.) Order Date :- 31.7.2020
